result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks visible pedestrian signals and has parked vehicles near the crossing that may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground near the Papa Nick's Pizza storefront

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use urban area with residential housing and a corner business. While sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and suffers from faded pavement markings and sightline obstructions due to parked cars.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked very close to the intersection corners obstruct the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Re-stripe the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners, but lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and presence of parked cars near the crossing points create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for an extended period without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and overhead traffic signals within a mixed-use urban environment. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing distance is significant and parked vehicles near the corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners can obscure pedestrians from the view of turning or approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on the far side and left side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to cross two lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing marked with zebra stripes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Constructing curb extensions would reduce the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the traffic lane.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjusting signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
